nodes.statement: PlasticOS MVP demonstrates single-writer native document originals, attributable exact evidence links, and side-effect-free operation-specific compliance gates on installed Odoo 19 Enterprise.

Native Documents AI and existing inference consumers, where available, produce source-bound candidates, contradictions and suggested next actions without acquiring domain write authority; manual evidence paths remain usable.

Architecture has reviewed contracts that could later support buyer-optional partial movements, many-to-many booking allocations, and revision-safe evidence without committing to Export or warehouse/shop-floor implementation.

Prioritize PlasticOS Odoo MVP and native-first Documents, invariant reconciliation and AI evidence safety; defer Export and physical operations implementations until separate approved stage and source proof.

Reusing existing native Odoo and PlasticOS single-writer boundaries for document evidence and AI-proposed actions reduces MVP risk while preserving optional Export and physical operations extensibility.
One source-authoritative PlasticOS Documents verification decision governs both native and business evidence surfaces; native bridge acts only as projection/delegation.
Document association only follows verified typed business identities and revisions, never partner recency; ambiguous originals stay unmatched and reviewable.

PlasticOS has a compatibility-proven one commercial transaction to many physical loads and partial quantities design for authorized domestic fulfillment; no buyer fiction or unapproved operations/export launch.
Effective Odoo model, field and company ACLs enforce approved least-privilege roles while document intake, claim workflow and transaction import remain usable.
Admit a no-loss PlasticOS invariants successor that resolves seed lifecycle, external intelligence failure semantics and effective access without weakening existing guards.

Close the three known Documents/Logistics correctness defects and constitutional contradictions through owner-approved bounded repairs with independent negative tests; keep Export and shop-floor implementation parked.
Eliminating competing fact writers, guessed links and silently narrowed movement cardinality improves trustworthy domestic operation and lowers later expansion migration risk.
Operate Scrap Management more profitably by discovering, converting and fulfilling better recycling transactions.

Odoo 19 sufficiently operational: historical data imported; web lead triage; logistics; enrichment and buyer matching usable even if imperfect. Historical working-plan intent, not current delivery proof.
Complete safe independently verified Odoo Staging-to-Production promotion when separately authorized, with rollback and smoke evidence.
Prioritize existing ERP integration, facility-profile enrichment, CEG validation and measurable economics without replacement architecture.
Keep human send/commit checkpoints until graduated by source-owned business policy and actual proof.
